description: Official GradeX relative risk rank in this inventory (column Rank). 1 is the highest ranked crossing in this list. The official preamble explains the factors used and their limits.
Official Transport Canada crossing identifier (column TC Number).
Responsible railway company as published (column Railway Company).
Official Transport Canada region code as published (column Region).
Official province or territory code as published (column Province).
English province or territory name corresponding to the official code. Added in this extract for readability.
Public or Private as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
F for federal or P for provincial, as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Railway mileage on the subdivision, in miles, as published.
Subdivision name as published.
Mileage on the spur, in miles, when the crossing is on a spur. Blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Spur name as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Location or road name as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Latitude as published. Blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Longitude as published. Blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Road authority as published (official CSV header is Road  Authority, with two spaces).
Warning system as published: Passive, Active - FLB, Active - FLBG, Other, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Number of accidents at this crossing over the last 5 years, as published, from Transportation Safety Board data according to the official dictionary.
Number of fatalities at this crossing over the last 5 years, as published, from Transportation Safety Board data according to the official dictionary. Official CSV header: Fatality.
Number of persons seriously injured at this crossing over the last 5 years, as published, from Transportation Safety Board data according to the official dictionary. Official CSV header: Injury.
Estimated daily train movements as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Estimated daily road vehicles as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Estimated maximum train speed in miles per hour as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Estimated road speed in kilometres per hour as published (official CSV header: Road Speed (km/h); official dictionary header: Road Max Speed (km/h)). Blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Number of road lanes as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Number of railway tracks as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen.
Y or N as published, or blank when the official file has a hyphen. Official CSV header: IsUrban.
Official province or territory code as published (column Province).
English province or territory name corresponding to the official code. Added in this extract for readability.
Count of official inventory rows in that province or territory.
Count of official rows in that province or territory that have both latitude and longitude.
Sum of official 5-year accident counts in that province or territory.
Sum of official 5-year fatality counts in that province or territory.
Sum of official 5-year serious injury counts in that province or territory.
Count of official rows with Access equal to Public.
Count of official rows with Access equal to Private.
Count of official rows with Jurisdiction equal to F.
Count of official rows with Jurisdiction equal to P.
Count of official rows with IsUrban equal to Y.
Count of official rows with IsUrban equal to N.
